summary: Cagayan 2nd District representative with 18 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant record found is entirely co-authored: an anti-dynasty bill, a no-work-no-pay measure for politicians, a medicine voucher program and a national forensic DNA database.
caveat: Co-authored bills only; anti-dynasty is a common coalition bill. DNA database and medicine voucher are single issues and not scored.
